candidate.title: Removing an Account
candidate.practicalProblem: Helps people remove a local account entry without mistaking local cleanup for relay erasure or losing the material needed to restore the same identity.

guide.directReaderVerification: The public reader could not open the guide during this run. Repository content, seven-locale paths and the registered media entry are verified; no independent live body, canonical or Open Graph claim is made.

publicVideo.title: How to Remove an Account from Nostr WoT
publicVideo.visibleDescriptionSummary: Remove a Nostr account from the extension, with a link to the written guide.

guideMediaBacklog: Removing accounts, change language, zapping auto-approve and authentication tutorials have registered public media without matching social files.
Removing accounts was selected because it solves a recovery and deletion-semantics problem and is not duplicated by an existing social entry.

supported: Removal deletes the local account entry, not the identity or its relay history.
Restoration requires the key or recovery phrase, and a derived account also requires its original derivation path.
Local permissions and wallet connections are not restored automatically.
notMade: Local removal deletes profiles or posts from relays.
A restore automatically recreates device-local permissions or wallet connections.

linkedin.reason: This is the Nostr WoT team's own substantive security and recovery tutorial, paired with its seven-language guide.

nostr.reason: The practical key-recovery and local-removal guidance is directly useful to Nostr users.
